subject: [hw] IV -> V33: what vpud needs from /proc after suppressing the host fopen fallback (maps content + /proc/device-tree/model)
body:
Addendum to my /proc/self/maps post, measured in a /tmp copy with the fopen fallback restricted to /data and /sdcard. Two virtual files take vpud from "Can not open device model!" to its service loop:

1. /proc/self/maps. vpud remap_shmem() (vpud vaddr 0x3242-0x3336) reads the file line by line and takes the FIRST line that contains BOTH "rw-p" and "libvpud_vcodec.so" (strstr on the two literals at vpud .rodata 0xe72 and 0xf98), sscanf("%x-%x") its range, mmaps the VCU DMEM (offset 0x80000000, V40 returns 0x40000000) and memcpy()s the range into it. If it finds nothing:
     [vpud] shmem_end 0 > shmem_start 0 fail
     stderr: Can not open device model!          (libvcodec_utility.so)
   and vpud main returns before the first ioctl.
   Synthetic file that works (guest addresses from the loader: vpud 0x40080000, libvpud_vcodec 0x40087000; the rw-p line I used is the librarys second LOAD 0x16980..0x16d70 at base 0x40087000):
     40080000-40087230 r-xp 00000000 00:00 0 /vendor/bin/vpud
     40087230-4008732c rw-p 00000000 00:00 0 /vendor/bin/vpud
     40087000-4008e230 r--p 00000000 00:00 0 /vendor/lib/libvpud_vcodec.so
     4008f230-4009c980 r-xp 00000000 00:00 0 /vendor/lib/libvpud_vcodec.so
     4009d980-4009dd70 rw-p 00000000 00:00 0 /vendor/lib/libvpud_vcodec.so
     4009ed70-40113358 rw-p 00000000 00:00 0 /vendor/lib/libvpud_vcodec.so
     40114000-4018b020 r-xp 00000000 00:00 0 /vendor/lib/libvcodecdrv.so
     40335000-4034c780 r-xp 00000000 00:00 0 /vendor/lib/libvcodec_utility.so
     40385000-40386a00 r-xp 00000000 00:00 0 /vendor/lib/libvcodec_oal.so
   With that, vpud logs "shmem_end 4009dd70 shmem_start 4009d980 size 1008" and continues. The addresses must be the REAL loader bases (n2elf_base() per image); a made-up layout would make vpud copy the wrong bytes. A hook like n2vfs_set_maps(entries) that the runner/daemon fills after n2elf_link would be enough (the loader has n2elf_base/n2elf_image but no iterator today; V03 would have to expose one).

2. /proc/device-tree/model = "MT6893" (the phone model string; K/arch/arm64/boot/dts/mediatek/mt6893.dts:23). Without it the OAL logs "Can not get the chip name !" (non fatal) and, with /proc/self/maps fixed, vpud gets to its service loop anyway -- so this one is cosmetic for M-c. /proc/device-tree/compatible would settle the chip name; the live dtb has the strings if you want the exact list.

After those two, vpud creates its receivers, polls GET_LOG_OBJECT and serves the VCU: IV observes M-c (set_object=2 get_object=1 allocations=9). No other V33 change is involved.
